## About
Boomer's Bar & Grill is a neighborhood spot at 7932 N Oak Trafficway in Kansas City. It's the kind of easygoing place where you can grab a drink, order something from the grill and shoot some pool with friends.
We're open late every day of the week and easy on the wallet. Folks have given us a 4 star rating across 638 Google reviews, and one first-time visitor called it a dive bar they loved.

## Services
- Pool and darts: Pool tables and darts, with cards too, according to one reviewer who came in to play and made some new friends.
- Potato skins: One reviewer says the potato skins are great.
- Saturday trivia: One reviewer mentions trivia on Saturday nights.

## FAQ
Q: What's happening on Saturday nights?
A: One reviewer came for music bingo on a Saturday night and called it a good time.

Q: What should I order?
A: One reviewer recommends the potato skins.

## What customers say
